Run on every ability in data.js, old (e4d5e1e) vs new onceTag: the only outputs that change are Direct the Slaughter (×3 lists) and Will of the Hive Mind, tag “Once per battle round”, text “Once per battle round, one model from your army with this ability can use it …”: “Once per battle round” → “Once per battle round, per army”. That is exactly what branch 2 already gave these rows before b6ab9ec gave them a tag (and what the approved result-r5/derive reviews describe: “, per army” only when the text says “one model from your army with this ability”), so the change restores the approved chip rather than adding a new reading. No other tagged row matches the army regex (Shadow in the Warp’s “one or more units from your army” does not), tags already saying “per army”/“per unit” (Bomb Squig “Once per turn, twice per battle, per unit”, Sorcerous Invigoration) are left alone by the guard, “ · Aura”-style suffixes are stripped before the guard is tested. The three enhancement tags give the same chips as before (Archslaughterer/Umbralefic “Once per battle, per army”, Incandaeum “Once per battle”). Latent only, no row has it: a tag saying “per model” would get “, per model, per army”, as the guard only knows army|unit (branch 2’s regex has the same scope). Side note, not a defect of this function: on Direct the Slaughter / Will of the Hive Mind the opened view’s meta line still prints the raw tag “Once per battle round” under the chip “Once per battle round, per army”.
